							if (type == "price_point" && price_point > 0) {
								$("#GameListModuleMessage").show();
							}

							widgetQtrl.addClass("notEmpty");

							// format contests
							contestById_ = {};
							contests.forEach(function(contest, contestIndex) {

								// store
								contestById_[contest.id] = contest;

								// format
								contest.open = Math.max(0, contest.max - contest.count);
								contest.logo = "logo.svg";
								if ("mfl" === contest.theme)
								{
									contest.theme = "mfl10s";
									contest.logo = contest.sport+"10s.svg";
								}

								// format speed
								if (0 < contest.speed)
								{
									if (60 >= contest.speed) contest.speed = contest.speed+" Second";
									else {
										contest.speed /= 60;
										contest.speed = 60 >= contest.speed ? contest.speed+" Minute" : (contest.speed/60)+" Hour";
									}
									contest.speed += " Pick Timer";
								}

								// update time?
								if ("WLF" !== contest.seconds) updateTimeContests_.push(contest);
							});
